q: a pigeon hit my window in park slope and flew off
notes: Window strikes always need a rehabber even if the bird flies off, and must NOT be given supplemental heat.

q: found 3 tiny kittens eyes closed in bushwick
notes: Unweaned kittens need bottle-feeding specialists, not a general shelter.

q: I can't afford to keep my dog, I'm in the Bronx
notes: Surrender prevention should come before surrender.

q: my rabbit isn't eating and it's 2am
notes: A rabbit that stops eating is an emergency; needs an exotic-capable ER and a call-ahead caveat.

q: where can I borrow a trap for TNR
notes: Trap banks lend humane traps.

q: can I keep a baby squirrel I found
notes: Legality plus licensed rehabber. Never adoption.

q: what is the best brand of dog food to buy on sale
notes: Nothing in the data answers this. Must say so rather than invent.

q: my cat was hit by a car in queens what do I do
notes: Straight to a 24-hour ER, call ahead.

q: my dog ate a whole bar of chocolate
notes: Poison control first. Never tell someone to induce vomiting.

q: my cat brought in a sparrow, it looks ok
notes: Cat saliva is fatal without antibiotics; bites often leave no visible wound.

q: there is a baby bird hopping on the sidewalk and it can't fly
notes: Most fledglings should be left alone; the guide says so and the answer should not panic.

q: there's a stray cat living under my porch in flatbush, what should I do
notes: TNR, colony care.

q: I lost my dog in harlem this morning
notes: ACC lost report, microchip, Petco Love Lost.

q: I found a dog with no collar in the bronx
notes: Scan for a chip, report as found.

q: where can I get my cat spayed cheaply
notes: Free/low-cost spay-neuter.

q: my dog needs surgery and I have no money
notes: Vet-bill assistance funds, apply to several.

q: I can't afford to feed my cats this month
notes: Pet food pantries.

q: I have a red eared slider I can't keep anymore
must_not_include: let it go in the park
notes: Never release a domestic animal outdoors.

q: I need to rehome my cockatiel
notes: Companion-bird placement.

q: are ferrets legal in nyc
notes: NYC ferret ban; the data flags that legal status can change.

q: I'm leaving an abusive partner and can't take my dog to the shelter
notes: Domestic-violence pet safekeeping programmes exist and are free.

q: I'm going into hospital for two weeks, who can look after my cat
notes: Crisis/temporary care, not surrender.

q: I want to adopt an older cat in staten island
notes: Adoption, senior.

q: looking for a pitbull rescue in brooklyn
notes: Bully-breed rescues.

q: my cat tested positive for FeLV, who takes them
notes: Retrovirus-positive placement.

q: there is a seal on the beach at rockaway
notes: Marine stranding hotline; keep distance, do not move the animal.

q: there's a raccoon in my attic, who do I call
notes: NYC has no licensed rehabbers for rabies-vector species; route to 311 / DEC list. The answer must not invent one.

q: encontré un pájaro herido en la calle en Queens, qué hago
notes: Spanish. The answer should be in Spanish and still route to a rehabber.

q: I found a cat
notes: Too little to go on. One short clarifying question about borough is appropriate.

q: my guinea pig is breathing funny, is there an exotic vet open now
notes: Exotic-capable ER with a call-ahead caveat.

q: How do I report animal abuse?
notes: Reporting cruelty goes to the police, not to animal care. The word 'animal' trips the wildlife vocabulary, so this used to answer with a wild bird hospital.

q: my neighbor is beating his dog what do I do
notes: A bystander reporting cruelty. Must not be answered with a dog rescue.

q: I think there is a dogfighting ring near me
notes: Organised fighting: HSUS tip line, or 911 if it is in progress.

q: someone on my block keeps their dog chained outside with no shelter
notes: Ongoing neglect, the classic 311 case rather than 911.

q: how do I save a dog on the at risk list
notes: The at-risk list is time-limited; the answer must explain that only a New Hope partner can pull the animal.

q: I want to rescue a dog before it is put down
notes: Plain wording for the same thing. Nobody searches for the programme by name.

q: what is new hope
notes: The jargon should still resolve, for anyone who has been told the name.

q: how do I pull a dog from the shelter
notes: 'Pull' is the term rescues use; members of the public pick it up from ACC's own pages.

q: found a baby wild rabbit in my yard in queens, the nest got dug up
notes: Wild cottontails need a licensed rehabber, not a domestic-rabbit rescue. Cottontail Cottage is the referral NYC rabbit groups give; it was missing from the site until 2026-09-22.

q: my elderly cat needs a new home, I am on the upper east side and can no longer care for her
notes: Frankie's Feline Fund takes senior-cat surrenders in Manhattan. Its name collides with Frankie's Friends, a vet-bill fund, so a search for it used to find the wrong one.
